amendment: After first public run: bind input hash and published source commit; add deduplication and analytic target diagnostics. Selection, class, decoder and scored data unchanged.
decoder: fewest literals among consistent hypotheses, then enumeration index
evidence_class: finite verified example and public synthetic pilot
hypothesis_class: all conjunctions of positive, negative or absent literals on eight public bits, plus constant false
primary_empirical_metric: root fraction with any candidate-classification error
primary_exact_check: decoded selected samples preserve the full training version space
scope: exact compression within a declared finite class of public Horn-step classifiers
selector: greedy cover of every hypothesis excluded by the full training sample
target: a checked candidate adds a fresh syntactic ancestor of the goal
